slides.title: Landscapers: 3 questions before the first frost
Q1: Adding snow removal this winter. Does your insurance cover it?
slides.body: Don't assume. Call your agent before the first storm.

slides.title: Q2: When do your truck registrations and crew licenses expire?
slides.body: Same truck, different dates. Write every one down.

slides.title: Q3: When does your applicator license renew?
slides.body: If your state requires one, check the date and any training it needs. Save this.
